About the Report
Our Integrated Annual Report adheres to the framework and guiding principles 
established by the International Integrated Reporting Council (‘IIRC’). It 
demonstrates our overall strategies and initiatives to the management of our 
business, creating value for our customers and other stakeholders.
Integrated Thinking in Action
We apply integrated thinking to shape our  
response to:
 
�
Material matters that affect our ability to create value
 
�
Short, medium and long-term priorities across financial 
and non-financial outcomes
 
�
Strategic resource allocation to strengthen 
competitive resilience
 
�
Sustainability imperatives including climate action, digital 
inclusion and human capital development
Our six capitals are integral to this process and determine 
 how we set targets, measure outcomes and manage trade-
offs. These capitals—financial, manufactured and intellectual, 
natural, human, social and relationship—are consistently 
referenced across this Report.
Our Reporting Framework
This Report is prepared in accordance with the guiding 
principles and content elements of the International 
Integrated Reporting Council ('IIRC') Framework, with 
disclosures mapped to the Global Reporting Initiative 
('GRI') Standards where applicable. Financial and statutory 
disclosures comply with the following:
 
�
The Companies Act, 2013
 
�
Indian Accounting Standards
 
�
SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015
 
�
Secretarial Standards issued by the Institute of Company 
Secretaries of India
Forward-looking Statement
Certain statements in this Report regarding our business 
operations may constitute forward-looking statements. These 
include all statements other than statements of historical facts, 
including those regarding the financial position, business strategy, 
management plans and objectives for future operations. Forward-
looking statements can be identified by words such as ‘believes’, 
‘estimates’, ‘anticipates’, ‘expects’, ‘intends’, ‘may’, ‘will’, ‘plans’, 
‘outlook’ and other words of similar meaning in connection with a 
discussion of future operating or financial performance. 
Forward-looking statements are necessarily dependent on 
assumptions, data or methods that may be incorrect or imprecise 
and that may be incapable of being realised and as such, are not 
intended to be a guarantee of future results but constitute our 
current expectations based on reasonable assumptions. Actual 
results could differ materially from those projected in any forward-
looking statements due to various events, risks, uncertainties and 
other factors. We neither assume any obligation nor intend to 
update or revise any forward-looking statements, whether as a 
result of new information, future events or otherwise.
Feedback
We welcome feedback and dialogue with our  
stakeholders.
 
�
For general comments:  
investor.relations@tatacommunications.com
 
�
For ESG-specific queries:  
EOHS@tatacommunications.com
Assurance
Our Approach
Financial disclosures presented herein have been audited by S. 
R. Batliboi & Associates LLP, our Statutory Auditor. Sustainability 
disclosures have undergone limited assurance by BSI Group 
India Private Limited. The Board of Directors and Management 
have reviewed the accuracy and completeness of all material 
content in this Report.
We continue to adopt integrated thinking as a cornerstone of 
our strategy and operations. Material matters are identified 
through stakeholder engagement and mapped to our strategy 
and capital allocation decisions. This integrated approach 
enables us to articulate how we deliver on our purpose, respond 
to external forces and manage interdependencies between 
financial and non-financial performance.
Reporting Period
Reporting Scope and Boundary
This Report covers the 12-month period (April 1, 2024 
to March 31, 2025). Where relevant, comparative data 
from earlier periods has been included to provide a 
contextual perspective.
This Report covers Tata Communications’ global operations 
and includes relevant information on our subsidiaries, 
associates, and key operating geographies where it is 
material to our performance and value-creation narrative. 
Any exclusions or boundary limitations are disclosed in the 
relevant sections.
The sustainability content aligns with internationally 
recognised disclosure practices and reflects our 
environmental, social and governance ('ESG') priorities across 
operations. The sustainability KPIs are disclosed in detail on 
our website through ESG Addendum and the GRI index.
©2025 Tata Communications. All rights reserved. TATA 
COMMUNICATIONS and TATA are trademarks of Tata Sons Private 
Limited. All other brands, logos and marks are property of their 
respective owners.
Who We Are
At Tata Communications, we are driving the future of a hyperconnected world. 
Evolving from a traditional telecom provider to a Digital Fabric innovator, we 
simplify complexity, enhance security, and elevate digital experiences—empowering 
businesses to thrive in the digital-first era.
Transforming Enterprises 
Through our Digital Fabric
Our comprehensive portfolio spans next-generation 
connectivity, cloud services, customer interaction 
solutions, IoT, media services and cybersecurity, 
all underpinned by our robust global network 
infrastructure. Our digital fabric of solutions integrates 
advanced platforms, tools and technologies to 
simplify complexities and help enterprises unlock new 
possibilities in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.
Mission
To enable enterprises to succeed in the new world of digital 
(technologies and business models) by being borderless and 
always available (to our customers and partners).
To achieve profitable 
growth and become a 
leading digital ecosystem 
enabler in the eyes of our 
customers and the industry.
Shared Ambition
DRIVE Ahead Behaviour
Ownership and accountability
Collaboration
Can-do attitude and growth mindset
Being agile
Innovation and problem solving
Continuous learning and skill transformation
Daring | Responsive | Inclusive | Venturing | Ethical
Through our global network accessible from over 
190 countries and territories, we enable seamless 
communication, secure data exchange and intelligent 
connectivity. Guided by our ethos of innovation 
and sustainability, we are committed to reducing 
environmental impact, promoting inclusive growth and 
creating long-term value for all stakeholders.
Vision
To deliver a New World of 
CommunicationsTM to advance 
the reach and leadership of 
customers as a global digital 
ecosystem enabler.
What Inspires
Us Everyday
